ActionDescriptions.ToAnalyzeAndImproveEntitiesWithinSession:
to extract session entities and propose ontology improvements
Loads the trusted workflow for extracting high-value entities from a target session, validating improvements against existing ontology/code/tools, and producing a merge plan with exact file targets and apply modes (item-by-item or batch).
ActionDescriptions.ToArchiveBuffalySession:
to mark a session as archived
sessionKey - exact existing session key to archive. Archives the session through targeted session metadata storage; this is not folder-moving cleanup and does not physically delete session files. Use only when the user asks to archive/remove a session from normal active lists.
ActionDescriptions.ToBootstrapWebhookTimelineEvent:
to bootstrap webhook timeline event handling
Bootstrap webhook timeline event handling and execute the next safest step.
ActionDescriptions.ToClearAllQueuedSessionMessages:
to clear all queued session messages
Destructive queue cleanup. Remove every next-turn queued message from the exact sessionKey and return the canonical remaining queue and QueuedCount. Use only after inspection and explicit authorization to discard all pending work; prefer ToRemoveQueuedSessionMessage for targeted cleanup. This does not remove pending live-steer messages.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateBuffalyChildSession:
to attach a buffaly child session to a parent session
parentSessionKey - existing parent session key. childSessionKey - child session key to ensure and attach under the parent. Prefer reusing an existing child session for the same task before creating another one; call ToGetChildSessions first unless there is a concrete reason to isolate work in a new child session. This action does not accept or set a model. To create a child with a specific model, create/attach the child first, call ToGetBuffalyProviderModelCatalog, then call ToSetBuffalySessionModelSelection with an exact catalog ModelName for the child session. Do not guess, alias, or normalize model names. Returns the canonical minimal session status result.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateBuffalySession:
to ensure a buffaly-agent session runtime exists
sessionKey - target session key. Ensures the session exists and is loaded as a Buffaly agent runtime. Reuse the same session when it already exists; do not create a new sibling session unless there is a concrete reason to isolate work. Does not send an instruction.
ActionDescriptions.ToCreateBuffalySiblingSession:
to attach a new session as a sibling of another session
sourceSessionKey - existing session whose parent should be reused. siblingSessionKey - session key to ensure and attach under the same parent. Fails when sourceSessionKey has no parent.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBuffalySessionParentKey:
to read a session parent session key
sessionKey - existing session key. Returns the authoritative parent session key, or an empty string when the session has no parent.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetChildSessions:
to reuse an existing child buffaly session
parentSessionKey - existing parent session key. Use this before creating a child session so the agent can reuse an existing child session when appropriate instead of creating duplicate sibling sessions. Returns the canonical shared session-status rows for existing child sessions.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetMostRecentSessionTurn:
to inspect recent child session output
sessionKey - target existing session key. Primary starting point for inspecting a session or checking child-session progress/result. Returns only the most recent turn summary, not raw history or tool result rows.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetQueuedSessionMessages:
to inspect a session input queue
sessionKey - exact target session key. Returns the canonical next-turn queue, including QueuedCount, DispatchInProgress, QueueItemId values, message text, and source metadata. This is read-only and does not consume or start queued work.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetRecentSessionTurns:
to get recent child session progress
sessionKey - target existing session key. maxTurns - small bounded count of the newest canonical turn summaries, default 5 and capped in C#. Results are chronological for display and HasMore indicates older canonical turns remain. Prefer ToGetMostRecentSessionTurn first for routine inspection; use this when a few recent turns are needed. Does not return raw tool result rows.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetSessionAssistantMessageMarkdown:
to get session message markdown by message key
sessionKey - target Buffaly session key. messageKey - message key to retrieve deterministically. Returns markdown as StringRef with metadata and normalized content text for the selected message.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetSessionStatus:
to fetch worker-aware session status
sessionKey - target existing session key. Returns the canonical minimal session status result for that session.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetSessionTurnDetail:
to inspect tool output within one turn
sessionKey - target existing session key. turnId - selected turn id from ToGetMostRecentSessionTurn, ToGetRecentSessionTurns, or ToGetSessionTurnPage. maxRows - optional detail row cap, defaults to 200 and is clamped by the host. This may contain a lot of data, including tool calls/results and lifecycle rows; prefer turn summaries unless specific evidence inside one turn is needed.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetSessionTurnPage:
to inspect older turn summaries
sessionKey - target existing session key. skipTurns - exact number of newest canonical turns to exclude before selecting the next older page. maxTurns - small bounded count, default 5 and capped in C#. Results are chronological within each page; HasMore is true only when older canonical turns remain. Use skipTurns += returned turn count to exhaust history without overlaps or gaps.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetUserState:
to fetch the full user state payload for a session
sessionKey - target session key. Returns the full stored user-state payload formatted as friendly JSON.
ActionDescriptions.ToListActiveSessions:
to get active session info rows
maxCount - maximum active sessions to return (defaults to 50). Returns the canonical minimal session status rows from the runtime service.
ActionDescriptions.ToListRecentSessions:
to get recent session hierarchy and activity
maxCount - maximum persisted sessions to return, 1..200 (default 50). skip - nonnegative rows to skip for paging (default 0). Returns canonical SessionInfo rows ordered by activity, including ParentSessionKey, AgentName, UpdatedUtc, LastFinalMessageUtc, and MessageCount. For discovery by session name or key, use ToSearchSessionsByNameOrKey first. Lists non-archived session metadata only; message content and archived sessions require explicit content/history search.
ActionDescriptions.ToPassUserStateToABuffalyAgent:
to pass user state to a Buffaly agent
Pass user state to a Buffaly agent using EvaluateInputContract.UserState and runtime-managed timeline injection.
ActionDescriptions.ToQueueLatestSessionMessage:
to replace a pending session message
Explicitly queue one next-turn message for which only the latest pending value matters. sessionKey - target session. queueKey - stable logical queue identity reused by this source session. instruction - latest self-contained queued message. While an earlier message with the same source and queueKey is pending, this replaces that row even when the two-message inter-session limit is reached; a new queueKey at the limit is rejected without mutation. This is queued delivery, not session status mutation and not live steering. Critics/helpers must not emit a second parent update for the observed session's queueKey. The receipt includes Accepted, Message, QueueItemId, MessageKey, QueuedCount, and ReplacedPending.
ActionDescriptions.ToQueueMessageToSession:
to queue an instruction for a child session
Queue exactly one new actionable assignment for later processing by the target session. This is never live delivery. Inter-session admission is limited to two queued messages; at the limit this returns Accepted=false without adding a row and directs the caller to inspect/replace a pending message with ToQueueLatestSessionMessage or use ToSendMessageToSession for immediate delivery. Never use this action for repeated progress/status or corrections to a pending handoff. The receipt includes Accepted, Message, QueueItemId, MessageKey, and canonical QueuedCount.
ActionDescriptions.ToRemoveQueuedSessionMessage:
to remove one queued session message
Remove exactly one next-turn queued message by queueItemId from the exact sessionKey, then return the canonical remaining queue and QueuedCount. Inspect first and preserve needed evidence; this does not remove steering messages or other queued rows.
ActionDescriptions.ToResolveTopCandidateAndRun:
to resolve top candidate action and run it with correct load handling
Resolve the top semantic candidate action and execute it with correct load-state handling.
ActionDescriptions.ToSearchSessionFinalAssistantMessages:
to find final assistant answers in session history
For session discovery by name or key, use ToSearchSessionsByNameOrKey first, then inspect the matching session directly. Use this action for message content or historical/archive coverage; a metadata miss is not an exhaustive content search. search - required content search text. maxRows - maximum returned messages, default 25; this does not cap candidates. searchScope - recent (default), deep, or all. Use recent first. maxMessageScanCount - recent 0 uses 2500 candidates; deep requires an explicit positive limit, start with 10000 and expand deliberately. all is an explicit unbounded historical scan. Results cover only the candidate window. Returns compact JSON with MessageID, SessionID, MessageKey, TurnKey, SequenceNumber, Role, Text, SearchScope, MaxMessageScanCount, and NextSearchSuggestion.
ActionDescriptions.ToSearchSessionMessages:
to find user messages in session history
For session discovery by name or key, use ToSearchSessionsByNameOrKey first, then inspect the matching session directly. Use this action for message content or historical/archive coverage; a metadata miss is not an exhaustive content search. search - required content search text. maxRows - maximum returned messages, default 25; this does not cap candidates. searchScope - recent (default), deep, or all. Use recent first. maxMessageScanCount - recent 0 uses 2500 candidates; deep requires an explicit positive limit, start with 10000 and expand deliberately. all is an explicit unbounded historical scan. Results cover only the candidate window. Returns compact JSON with MessageID, SessionID, MessageKey, TurnKey, SequenceNumber, Role, Text, SearchScope, MaxMessageScanCount, and NextSearchSuggestion.
ActionDescriptions.ToSearchSessionsByNameOrKey:
to find a session by key
search - session name or key substring. maxCount - maximum matching sessions, 1..200 (default 50). skip - nonnegative matching rows to skip (default 0). For session discovery, search names/keys here before searching message content, then inspect the matching session directly. Returns canonical SessionInfo rows ordered by activity. Searches non-archived session metadata only, not message content or archived sessions; no match does not prove a session never existed. Use explicit bounded message-content search when content or historical/archive coverage is required. Empty search lists recent sessions with the same bounds.
ActionDescriptions.ToSendMessageToSession:
to steer a session
Send one message to an existing session using immediate steering. A running session receives the message in its current work; an idle or unloaded session is started to process it. Returns an admission receipt without waiting for the recipient to finish. Does not append a deferred next-turn queue item. Use ToQueueMessageToSession only when queuing is explicitly intended. Acceptance is not completion. Routine progress should stay in the sender's durable record. For support requests supply all five presentation fields: presentationTitle (plain incident/request title, max160), presentationSummary (reported error and why help is needed, max2000), requestedAction (max600), owner (incident investigator, max500), scope (existing authority, max300). Retain complete instructions/evidence in instruction. All five may be omitted for ordinary messages; partial fields fail before sending. Presentation is operator-only and grants no authority.
ActionDescriptions.ToSetBuffalySessionParent:
to attach an existing buffaly session to an existing parent session
sessionKey - existing child/session key to update. parentSessionKey - existing parent session key to assign. Both values must be exact session keys, not display names; this tool never creates sessions, rejects self-parenting and parent cycles, and returns SessionName plus ParentSessionName so callers can verify the relationship clearly.
ActionDescriptions.ToUnarchiveBuffalySession:
to mark a session as not archived
sessionKey - exact existing session key to unarchive. Restores the session through targeted session metadata storage without loading or mutating runtime state. Use when the user asks to restore an archived session to normal session lists.
